name: Sorcerer Scion of Civility
body:
Scions of civility are fair-handed individuals dedicated to fostering the growth of civilized communities through cooperation and compromise.

A scion of civility has the following class features.

Civilized Studies

A scion of civility may choose Knowledge (engineering), Knowledge (history), or the class skill specified for her bloodline.

This alters the bloodline class skill.

Peacemaker Spells

A scion of civility must take the following bonus spells at the specified levels in place of the bonus spells dictated by her bloodline: serenity (13th level) and euphoric tranquility (17th level).

This alters the bloodline bonus spells.

Sweeten the Pot

A scion of civility adds Skill Focus (Diplomacy) and Voice of the Sibyl to her list of bloodline bonus feats.

This alters bloodline bonus feats.

Master Mediator (Ex)

At 1st level, a scion of civility adds half her class level (minimum 1) to Profession (diplomat) skill checks.

Additionally, a scion of civility can use her bonus in Profession (diplomat) in place of her bonus in Diplomacy and Knowledge (local). When substituting in this way, a scion of civility uses her total Profession (diplomat) skill bonus, including class skill bonus and master mediator bonus, in place of the Diplomacy and Knowledge (local) bonuses, regardless of whether or not she has ranks in either Diplomacy or Knowledge (local) or if they are class skills. This replaces bloodline arcana.

Law Rules (Ex)

At 3rd level, a scion of civility gains the rule of law bloodline power.

Rule of Law (Ex)

At 3rd level, you gain DR1/chaotic. At 9th level, your damage reduction increases to DR2/chaotic.

This replaces the 3rd level bloodline power.
